He looked around at all of them, then looked at the man and said, "Stretch out your hand." The man did, and his hand was perfectly restored. The religious leaders were absolutely furious and immediately started discussing how to take Jesus out.

Drafting the Starting Lineup Around this time, Jesus went out to a mountainside and spent the entire night praying to God. When the sun came up, he called his followers together and officially drafted twelve of them to be his "Apostles" (his core messengers). The squad was: Simon (who he renamed Peter), his brother Andrew, James, John, Philip, Bartholomew, Matthew, Thomas, James (son of Alphaeus), Simon the Zealot, Judas (son of James), and Judas Iscariot (the guy who eventually became the traitor).

The Upside-Down Rulebook (The Sermon on the Plain) Jesus came down the mountain with his new crew and stood on a level area with a massive crowd. People had come from all over the country to hear him and get healed. Power was literally coming out of him, curing everyone.
He looked at his disciples and delivered a speech that completely flipped the world's definition of success upside down:

The Blessings: "You are incredibly blessed when you are poor, because the kingdom of God is yours. You are blessed when you are hungry right now, because you will be satisfied. You are blessed when you weep, because you will laugh. And you are blessed when people hate you, exclude you, and trash-talk you just because you follow me. Jump for joy when that happens, because your reward in heaven is going to be massive!"

The Reality Check: "But watch out if you are rich right now—you've already gotten all the comfort you're going to get. Watch out if you are stuffed with food—you will go hungry. Watch out if you're laughing it up now—you will mourn and weep. And watch out if everyone thinks you're awesome and popular—that's exactly how their ancestors treated the fake prophets."

Savage Love "But to those of you who are actually listening, I say this: Love your enemies. Do good to the people who hate you. Bless the people who curse you. Pray for the people who treat you like dirt. If someone punches you on one cheek, turn and offer them the other one too. If someone steals your coat, give them your shirt as well.

Treat other people exactly how you want them to treat you. If you only love people who love you back, what's so special about that? Even the worst sinners do that. If you only do favors for your friends, big deal. Love your enemies! Be merciful, exactly like your Father is merciful."

Stop Playing Referee "Stop judging other people, and you won't be judged. Forgive, and you will be forgiven. Why do you obsess over the tiny speck of sawdust in your buddy's eye, but completely ignore the massive wooden beam sticking out of your own eye? You're a hypocrite! Take the plank out of your own eye first, and then you'll actually be able to see clearly to help your friend."

The Rock vs. The Dirt "A good tree doesn't produce rotten fruit, and a rotten tree doesn't produce good fruit. You can tell what a person is really like by what they say—whatever is overflowing in their heart is what comes out of their mouth.

Why do you guys call me 'Lord, Lord,' but you don't actually do what I say? Whoever listens to my words and puts them into action is like a smart builder who digs deep and builds the foundation of his house on solid rock. When the river floods and the water smashes against the house, it doesn't even shake. But the guy who hears my words and ignores them is like a fool who builds a house on the dirt with absolutely no foundation. The second the flood hits it, it completely collapses into a massive wreck."
After Jesus finished his massive speech, he headed into the town of Capernaum.
There was a Roman Centurion (a high-ranking, tough-as-nails commander of the occupying enemy army) who had a servant he highly valued. The servant was incredibly sick and about to die.

When the Centurion heard about Jesus, he sent some respected Jewish leaders to ask Jesus to come save his servant. They pleaded with Jesus: "This guy actually deserves your help. He loves our nation and even paid to build our synagogue."
Jesus went with them. But when he got close to the house, the Centurion sent friends out to stop him with a message:

"Lord, don't bother coming all the way here. I'm not worthy to have you under my roof. Just say the word from right where you are, and my servant will be healed. I know exactly how authority works. I tell a soldier to go, and he goes. I tell a guy to do this, and he does it."

When Jesus heard that, he was absolutely blown away. He turned to the massive crowd following him and said, "I'm telling you, I haven't found faith this massive anywhere in all of Israel." When the messengers got back to the house, the servant was completely healed.
§Crashing a Funeral

Soon after, Jesus went to a town called Nain. As he walked up to the town gate, a funeral procession was coming out. A young guy had died, and he was the only son of his mother, who was already a widow.
When Jesus saw her crying, his heart absolutely broke for her. He walked right up and said, "Don't cry."

Then he stepped up and actually touched the coffin. The guys carrying it froze. Jesus looked at the dead body and said, "Young man, I say to you, get up!" The dead guy literally sat right up and started talking. Jesus handed him back to his mom.
The crowd was completely terrified and started praising God. "A massive prophet has shown up! God has come to help his people!"
§John the Baptist's Doubts

Meanwhile, John the Baptist was locked up in prison, and it was messing with his head. He sent two of his guys to ask Jesus, "Are you really the Messiah we've been waiting for, or should we keep looking for someone else?"

Right then, Jesus cured a bunch of people and kicked out some demons. He told John's guys, "Go back and tell John exactly what you just saw: the blind can see, the paralyzed are walking, the dead are waking up, and the poor are hearing good news. Tell him not to doubt me."

After they left, Jesus hyped up John to the crowd: "John isn't some soft guy wearing fancy silk suits in a palace. He is the greatest prophet who ever lived. But honestly, even the least important person in God's kingdom is greater than him."
§The Ultimate Forgiveness Flex

One of the strict religious experts, a Pharisee named Simon, invited Jesus over for a fancy dinner. While they were eating, a woman who had a terrible, shady reputation in the city found out Jesus was there. She crashed the exclusive party, bringing a jar of insanely expensive perfume.
She stood behind Jesus, crying so hard her tears were falling on his feet. She actually wiped his feet with her hair, kissed them, and poured the perfume on them.
Simon the Pharisee was disgusted. He thought, "If this guy was a real prophet, he'd know this woman is outcasts and he'd kick her out."
Jesus read his mind. "Simon, I have something to tell you."
"Tell me, Teacher."
"Two guys owed money to a banker. One owed five hundred bucks, the other owed fifty. Neither could pay, so the banker completely canceled both debts. Which guy will love the banker more?"
Simon said, "Obviously the one who had the massive debt canceled."

Jesus looked right at the woman but kept talking to Simon: "Exactly. Look at this woman. I came into your house, and you didn't even give me water for my dusty feet. She washed them with her tears. You didn't greet me with a kiss; she hasn't stopped kissing my feet. You didn't put oil on my head; she poured perfume on my feet.
Her massive, many sins have been completely forgiven—and that is why she has shown massive love. But a person who is only forgiven a little bit, only loves a little bit."
He looked at the woman and said, "Your sins are forgiven. Your faith has saved you. Go in peace."

After this, Jesus started traveling from town to town, dropping the good news about God's kingdom. His twelve main guys were with him, but so were a group of women who had been healed of evil spirits and diseases.

One of them was Mary Magdalene (Jesus had kicked seven demons out of her), along with Joanna (whose husband was the manager of King Herod's household), Susanna, and a bunch of others. These women were actually bankrolling the entire road trip out of their own pockets.
§The Story of the Dirt
§A massive crowd gathered, and Jesus told them a story:
"A farmer went out to plant seeds.
As he tossed the seed, some fell on the hard walking path. People stepped on it, and the birds ate it instantly.
Some fell on rock. It sprouted, but the plants dried up because there was no moisture.
Some fell in the thorn bushes, and the thorns choked the plants to death.
But some fell on good, rich dirt. It grew and produced a massive crop—a hundred times more than what was planted!"
His disciples pulled him aside later. "What does that actually mean?"

Jesus broke it down: "The seed is God's word. The hard path is people who hear it, but the devil immediately snatches it out of their hearts so they can't be saved. The rock is people who get incredibly excited at first, but the second things get tough, they quit. The thorns are people who hear the word, but their faith gets completely choked out by the stress, money, and distractions of life. But the good dirt? That's the people with honest, good hearts who hold onto the word and patiently produce a massive harvest."
§Defeating the Hurricane
One day, Jesus and his squad got into a boat to cross the lake.
While they were sailing, Jesus took a nap. Suddenly, a sudden hurricane whipped down onto the lake. The boat was taking on water, and they were in serious danger of drowning.
The disciples stunned him awake, screaming, "Master! Master! We're going to die!"
Jesus woke up, totally calm, and yelled at the wind and the raging waves to stop. Instantly, the storm died, and the water was perfectly flat.
He looked at his crew. "Where is your faith?"
They were absolutely terrified and completely mind-blown. They whispered to each other, "Who is this guy?! He commands the actual weather, and it obeys him!"
§The Graveyard Zombie

They landed on the other side. The second Jesus stepped off the boat, a totally naked, insane guy who lived in the town graveyard ran up to him. This guy was possessed by demons and had been chained up by the locals multiple times, but he always snapped the chains with supernatural strength and ran out into the wild.
He fell at Jesus's feet and the demon inside him screamed, "What do you want with me, Jesus, Son of the Most High God?! Don't torture me!"
Jesus asked, "What's your name?"
"Legion," he replied, because an entire army of demons had invaded him.

The demons begged Jesus not to throw them into the Abyss, but to let them go into a massive herd of pigs feeding on the hill. Jesus gave the order. The demons shot out of the man and into the pigs. The entire herd went totally insane and stampeded right off a steep cliff, plunging into the lake and drowning.

The pig farmers ran away and told the whole town. When the locals showed up, they saw the once-insane guy sitting right at Jesus's feet, fully dressed and completely normal. It completely freaked the locals out, and they begged Jesus to leave their territory. Jesus told the healed man, "Go home and tell everyone what God has done for you."
§The Double Miracle
When Jesus crossed back over the lake, a synagogue leader named Jairus fell at his feet, begging Jesus to come to his house because his twelve-year-old daughter was dying.

As Jesus was walking there, the massive crowd was crushing him. A woman who had been suffering from constant internal bleeding for twelve straight years (and had spent all her money on doctors with no cure) snuck up behind him. She barely touched the edge of his jacket, and instantly, her bleeding completely stopped.
Jesus stopped walking. "Who touched me?"
Peter laughed. "Boss, there are hundreds of people crushing you right now."
Jesus said, "No, someone deliberately touched me. I felt power go out from me."
The woman, trembling, fell at his feet and admitted it in front of everyone. Jesus smiled at her. "Daughter, your faith has healed you. Go in peace."
Right at that moment, someone from Jairus's house ran up and said, "Your daughter is dead. Don't bother the Teacher anymore."
Jesus heard him and said to Jairus, "Don't be afraid. Just believe, and she will be healed."

When they got to the house, everyone was wailing and sobbing loudly. Jesus walked in and said, "Stop crying! She isn't dead; she's just asleep." They literally laughed in his face because they knew she was a corpse.
Jesus took her by the hand and called out, "My child, get up!" Her spirit immediately returned, and she stood right up. Her parents were completely out of their minds with shock.

Jesus called the Twelve together and gave them ultimate power and authority to kick out all demons and cure diseases. He sent them out on a massive road trip to preach God's kingdom and heal the sick.

His instructions were hardcore: "Take absolutely nothing for the journey. No walking stick, no backpack, no bread, no money, no extra shirt. Stay wherever people welcome you. If a town rejects you, shake the dust off your feet when you leave as a warning to them."
They went out, crushing it from village to village.
§Feeding the 5,000

When the apostles got back, Jesus tried to take them to a town called Bethsaida for a quiet retreat. But the crowds found out and tracked him down. He welcomed them, taught them, and healed the sick all day.
By late afternoon, the Twelve came to him: "Send the massive crowd away so they can go to the surrounding villages and buy food. We're in the middle of nowhere."
Jesus said, "You feed them."
They panicked. "We only have five loaves of bread and two fish! Do you want us to go buy groceries for all these people?" (There were about 5,000 men there, plus women and kids).
Jesus said, "Have them sit down in groups of fifty."

He took the five loaves and two fish, looked up to heaven, gave thanks, and broke them. He handed the food to the disciples to pass out. Miraculously, the food just kept multiplying. Everyone ate until they were totally stuffed, and the disciples even picked up twelve full baskets of leftovers!
§The Ultimate Question and the Cross
One day, when Jesus was praying alone with his crew, he asked them, "Who do the crowds say I am?"
They replied, "Some say John the Baptist, others say Elijah, or one of the ancient prophets come back to life."
"But what about you?" he asked. "Who do you say I am?"
Peter stepped up and nailed it: "You are God's Messiah."

Jesus strictly warned them not to tell anyone yet. Then he dropped a massive reality check: "The Son of Man is going to suffer horribly. The religious leaders are going to reject him and kill him. But on the third day, he will be raised back to life."
He looked at all of them and laid out the terms of following him:

"If any of you want to be my follower, you have to completely put yourself second. You have to pick up your cross every single day and follow my lead. If you spend your life desperately trying to save it, you'll lose it. But if you lose your life for me, you'll save it. What good is it if you gain the entire world, but you lose or destroy your own soul?"
The Mountain Transformation (The Transfiguration)

About eight days later, Jesus took Peter, John, and James hiking up a mountain to pray. As he was praying, the appearance of his face completely changed, and his clothes became blindingly bright, like a flash of lightning.
Suddenly, two dead legends—Moses and Elijah—showed up in glorious splendor and started talking with Jesus about his upcoming death in Jerusalem.

Peter and the guys had been sleeping, but they woke up and saw Jesus's massive glory. Peter, terrified and not knowing what to say, babbled, "Master, this is awesome! Let's build three shrines right here!"
While he was talking, a cloud covered them, and God's voice thundered out of the cloud: "This is my Son, whom I have chosen. Listen to him!" When the voice stopped, it was just Jesus alone.
§The Fail and the Real Flex

The next day, when they came down the mountain, a massive crowd met them. A man begged Jesus, "Look at my only son! An evil spirit keeps seizing him, throwing him into violent convulsions with foam at his mouth. I begged your disciples to kick it out, but they couldn't."
Jesus sighed. "You unbelieving, stubborn generation. How long do I have to put up with you? Bring your son here."

Even while the boy was walking over, the demon threw him to the ground in a violent seizure. Jesus rebuked the evil spirit, healed the boy instantly, and handed him back to his dad. Everyone was mind-blown by the sheer greatness of God.
While everyone was marveling at the miracles, the disciples actually started arguing among themselves about which one of them was the greatest.

Jesus knew what they were thinking. He grabbed a little kid, stood him by his side, and roasted their egos: "Whoever welcomes a little kid like this in my name, welcomes me. The guy who is the least among all of you—he is the one who is truly great."
§No Looking Back
As they hit the road for Jerusalem, a guy walked up and said, "I will follow you anywhere you go."
Jesus gave it to him straight: "Foxes have dens, and birds have nests, but the Son of Man doesn't even have a place to sleep."
He told another guy, "Follow me."
The guy said, "Lord, let me go bury my father first."
Jesus said, "Let the spiritually dead bury their own dead. Your job is to go preach the kingdom of God."
Another guy said, "I'll follow you, Lord, but let me go say goodbye to my family first."

Jesus replied with a farming metaphor: "Nobody who puts his hand to the plow and keeps looking back is fit for service in the kingdom of God." (Translation: If you want to follow me, you have to be all in. No distractions.)
Jesus decided his core team of 12 wasn't enough to reach everyone, so he drafted a massive secondary squad of 72 followers. He sent them out in pairs ahead of him to every town he planned to visit.

His pre-game speech was intense: "The harvest is massive, but the workers are few. I'm sending you out like lambs into a pack of wolves. Pack light—no money, no bag, no extra sandals. Don't even stop to chat on the road. When you enter a town, heal the sick and tell them, 'The kingdom of God is right here.' If a town rejects you, wipe their dust off your feet and leave."
The 72 went out and came back absolutely hyped. "Lord, even the demons submit to us when we use your name!"

Jesus smiled. "I saw Satan fall like lightning from heaven. I have given you authority to trample on snakes and scorpions and to overcome all the power of the enemy. But don't flex about the demons obeying you. Flex about this: your names are written in heaven."
§The Ultimate Rivalry (The Good Samaritan)
A religious lawyer tried to trap Jesus with a technical question: "Teacher, what do I have to do to inherit eternal life?"
Jesus asked, "What does the Law say?"
The lawyer answered, "Love God with everything you have, and love your neighbor as yourself."
Jesus said, "Nailed it. Do that, and you'll live."
But the lawyer wanted to look smart and find a loophole, so he asked, "Okay, but who exactly is my neighbor?"
Jesus answered with one of the most famous stories of all time:
"A Jewish guy was hiking down the treacherous, winding road from Jerusalem to Jericho.
He got jumped by a gang of muggers. They stripped him, beat him half to death, and left him bleeding in the dirt.

A Jewish priest happened to be walking down the same road. He saw the dying guy, but crossed over to the other side and ignored him. Next, a Levite (a Temple assistant) walked by. He did the exact same thing—ignored him.

But then a Samaritan walked by." (Jews and Samaritans hated each other. They were massive, bitter rivals.) "When the Samaritan saw the Jewish guy, his heart broke. He bandaged the guy's wounds, put him on his own donkey, took him to a hotel, and stayed up all night taking care of him. The next day, the Samaritan paid the hotel manager out of his own pocket and said, 'Take care of him. If it costs more, I'll pay you back when I return.'
Jesus looked at the lawyer. "Which of those three guys was an actual neighbor to the man who got mugged?"
The lawyer couldn't even bring himself to say the word 'Samaritan.' He just muttered, "The one who showed mercy."
Jesus said, "Go and do exactly what he did."
§Martha's Stress Trap
Jesus and his crew stopped at the house of two sisters, Martha and Mary.
Mary immediately sat down right at Jesus's feet to listen to him teach. Martha, on the other hand, was running around like crazy, stressing out about cooking a massive meal and cleaning the house.
Martha finally snapped, marched up to Jesus, and said, "Lord, don't you even care that my sister left me to do all the work by myself?! Tell her to get up and help me!"

Jesus gently roasted her: "Martha, Martha. You are stressing and panicking about a million different things. But only one thing actually matters right now. Mary chose the right thing, and I'm not taking it away from her."
One day, after Jesus finished praying, his guys asked him, "Lord, teach us how to pray."
Jesus gave them a tight, simple, no-nonsense template (The Lord's Prayer):
"Father, show us who you are. Bring your kingdom here. Give us the food we need for today. Forgive our sins, because we forgive everyone who wrongs us. And keep us from giving in to temptation."

He told them a story to prove that God actually wants to answer them: "Imagine going to your buddy's house at midnight and pounding on the door saying, 'Listen, I need three loaves of bread, I have guests!' Your buddy yells, 'Go away, my kids are asleep!' But if you just keep knocking and being shamelessly annoying, he'll eventually get up and give you the bread just to make you stop.

So here is the rule: Keep asking, and you will receive. Keep seeking, and you will find. Keep knocking, and the door will open. If human dads know how to give good gifts to their kids, don't you think your Father in heaven will give the Holy Spirit to the people who ask?"
§The Finger of God

Jesus kicked a demon out of a guy who couldn't speak. Instantly, the guy started talking. But some haters in the crowd said, "He's only doing that because he's using the power of Beelzebul, the boss of the demons."

Jesus shut down their terrible logic: "If a kingdom is divided against itself, it collapses. Why would Satan fight his own guys? But if I am driving out demons by the actual finger of God, that means God's kingdom just crashed your party."
§The Sign of Jonah

Some people demanded a miracle as proof. Jesus said, "This generation is evil — it keeps demanding a sign, but the only sign it will get is the sign of Jonah. Jonah was a sign to the people of Nineveh, and the Son of Man will be a sign to this generation. The people of Nineveh will stand up at the judgment and condemn you, because they repented when Jonah preached — and someone far greater than Jonah is standing right here."
§The Lamp

"Nobody lights a lamp and hides it under a bowl. You put it on a stand so everyone can see. Your eye is the lamp of your body — when your eye is healthy, your whole body is full of light. So make sure the light inside you isn't actually darkness."
§The Dinner Party Roast
A Pharisee invited Jesus over for dinner. Jesus sat down without doing the super-strict, traditional ceremonial hand-washing routine first. The Pharisee was visibly shocked.
Jesus saw his reaction and absolutely went off on the religious leaders:
"You guys obsess over cleaning the outside of the cup, but your insides are completely stuffed with greed and wickedness! You fools! Didn't God make the inside too?"
"You make sure you tithe exactly 10% of your tiny garden herbs like mint and rue, but you completely ignore actual justice and the love of God!"

"You love getting the honored seats at the synagogue and having people treat you like celebrities in the marketplace. You're like unmarked graves—people walk over you and get spiritually contaminated without even knowing it!"
One of the legal experts said, "Teacher, when you insult them, you're insulting us too."
Jesus didn't back down. "Woe to you legal experts too! You crush people with massive lists of impossible religious rules, but you won't lift one finger to help them carry the load!"
After that dinner, the religious leaders were furiously plotting how to catch him saying something illegal so they could destroy him.

By this time, the crowd had swelled to thousands—so many people they were literally stepping on each other. Jesus turned to his disciples first and said, "Watch yourselves around the Pharisees. Their whole religion is one big performance—and that kind of fake is contagious, like yeast spreading through dough."

"You can't keep your true self hidden forever. Everything that's covered up will eventually be uncovered, and every secret will come out into the open. Whatever you've whispered in a dark room will be shouted from the rooftops."
§Don't Be Afraid

"I'm telling you, friends—don't be afraid of people who can kill your body but can't do anything after that. Let me tell you who to actually be afraid of: Be afraid of God, who has the power to kill AND throw you into hell. Yeah, he's the one to respect."

"What's a sparrow cost? Like, basically nothing—five for two pennies. But God doesn't forget a single one of them. And you? Even the hairs on your head are all counted. So don't be afraid. You're worth more than a whole flock of sparrows."

"Here's the deal: If you stand up for me in front of people, I'll stand up for you in front of God's angels. But if you pretend you don't know me in front of others, I'll do the same when I'm standing before the angels."
"And listen—if someone talks trash about me, the Son of Man, that can be forgiven. But if someone blasphemes against the Holy Spirit, there's no coming back from that."

"When they drag you into synagogues and put you on trial in front of officials and authorities, don't stress about what to say or how to defend yourself. The Holy Spirit will give you the exact words you need right in that moment."
§The Story of the Greedy Farmer
Someone from the crowd called out, "Teacher, tell my brother to split the inheritance with me!"

Jesus said, "Mister, who made me a judge or mediator over your family drama?" Then he turned to the crowd and said, "Watch out! Guard yourselves against every kind of greed. Your life isn't measured by how much stuff you own."
Then he told them this story: "There was this rich farmer whose land produced an insane harvest. He thought to himself, 'What am I gonna do? I don't have enough room to store all this!'"

"Then he said, 'I know what I'll do—I'll tear down my barns and build bigger ones. Then I'll store all my grain and goods, and I'll say to myself: Self, you've done well! You've got it made. Time to retire. Kick back, relax, and live it up!'"
"But that very night, God showed up and said, 'You fool! Tonight you die. And all that stuff you hoarded—who gets it now?'"
"That's exactly what happens when you spend your life filling your barn with stuff for yourself instead of being rich toward God."
§Steep Yourself in God-Reality
He continued talking to his disciples. "Don't stress about what's for dinner or whether your clothes are trendy enough. Life is way more than food, and your body is way more than what you wear."
"Look at the ravens—they don't plant crops or store food in barns, yet God feeds them. And you are worth SO much more than birds!"

"Has anyone ever added a single hour to their life by worrying? If worrying can't even do something that small, why worry about the rest? Look at the wildflowers—they don't stress about their appearance, but honestly, even the best-dressed celebrities look basic compared to them. If God puts that much care into flowers that are here today and gone tomorrow, don't you think he'll take care of YOU?"

"What I'm trying to get you to do is relax. Stop being so obsessed with getting stuff, so you can actually respond to what God is giving you. People who don't know God stress about all this, but you know him and how he works. Focus on God's kingdom, and all your everyday needs will be handled. Don't be afraid of missing out. You're my closest friends! The Father WANTS to give you the kingdom itself."

"Be generous. Give to the poor. Build up treasure in heaven—a bank account that never gets hacked, never loses value, never gets robbed. Because wherever your treasure is, that's where your heart will be too."
§When the Master Shows Up
"Stay ready! Keep your shirts on and your lights burning! Be like servants waiting for their boss to come back from a wedding—awake and ready to open the door the second he knocks."

"Those servants are blessed if the master finds them alert when he arrives. I'm telling you the truth—he'll put on an apron, sit them down at the table, and serve THEM a meal. It doesn't matter if he shows up at midnight or 3 AM—if they're awake and ready, they're blessed!"
"Think about it: if a homeowner knew exactly when a burglar was coming, he wouldn't leave his house unlocked. So stay ready! The Son of Man is going to show up when you least expect it."
Peter spoke up: "Lord, are you telling this story just for us, or for everyone?"

The Lord answered, "Think about it—who's the trustworthy, smart manager that the master puts in charge of feeding his household on schedule? That manager is blessed if the master comes home and finds him doing his job well. Trust me, he'll put that person in charge of everything he owns."

"But what if that manager thinks, 'My boss is taking forever to come back,' and starts beating the other servants, partying, and getting drunk? The master will show up on a day he doesn't expect, at a time he doesn't know, and it will NOT be pretty. He'll be demoted back to the bottom."

"The servant who knows what his master wants but doesn't do it will be punished severely. But the one who messes up out of ignorance will get a lighter punishment. When you've been given a lot, a lot will be expected. When you've been entrusted with much, even more will be demanded."
§To Start a Fire

"I came to set the earth on fire—and I wish it were already blazing! I have a baptism to go through, and I can't rest until it's complete. Do you think I came to bring peace on earth? No way. I came to bring division!"

"From now on, families of five will be split—three against two, two against three. Fathers against sons, sons against fathers. Mothers against daughters, daughters against mothers. In-laws against each other."

Then he turned to the crowd: "When you see clouds rolling in from the west, you say, 'Rain's coming'—and you're right. When the south wind blows, you say, 'It's gonna be hot'—and you're right. Hypocrites! You know how to read the weather, but you can't read what's happening right now in God's timeline?"

"Why can't you figure out for yourselves what's right? If someone's taking you to court, try to settle things on the way there. Otherwise, the judge will hand you over to the officer, and the officer will throw you in jail. Trust me—you won't get out until you've paid every last penny."
Some people told Jesus a horrific news story about how the Roman governor Pilate had slaughtered some Galileans while they were worshipping.

Jesus asked, "Do you think those people were murdered because they were worse sinners than everyone else? Absolutely not. But I'm telling you, unless you change your life and turn back to God, you will all perish too."

"And what about those eighteen people who were crushed when the tower of Siloam collapsed? Do you think they were worse sinners than everyone else in Jerusalem? No way. But unless you repent, you will all perish too."

He told a story about a guy who had a fig tree that hadn't produced fruit in three years. The guy told his gardener, "Chop it down, it's taking up space." The gardener pleaded, "Give me one more year to fertilize it. If it produces, great. If not, we chop it down." (Jesus's point: God is giving you a second chance. Don't waste it.)
§The Sabbath Showdown (Again)

Jesus was teaching in a synagogue on the Sabbath. A woman walked in who had been crippled by an evil spirit for 18 solid years. She was bent completely double and literally couldn't stand up straight.
Jesus called her over, put his hands on her, and said, "Woman, you are totally free from your sickness." Instantly, she snapped upright and started praising God.
The leader of the synagogue was absolutely furious that Jesus healed on the day of rest. He yelled at the crowd, "There are six days for working! Come get healed on those days, not on the Sabbath!"

Jesus absolutely roasted him in front of everyone: "You hypocrites! Every single one of you unties your ox or your donkey and leads it out to get water on the Sabbath. This woman is a daughter of Abraham, and Satan has kept her chained in a cage for 18 years! Shouldn't she be untied from her chains on the Sabbath?"
The haters were completely humiliated, and the massive crowd went wild, totally loving everything Jesus was doing.
§The Narrow Door
§The Tiny Seed

"What is God's kingdom like?" Jesus asked. "It's like a mustard seed — the tiniest seed anyone plants — that grows into a massive tree where birds build nests in its branches. It's also like yeast: a woman mixes a tiny bit into a huge batch of dough, and the whole thing rises."
Someone asked Jesus, "Lord, are only a few people going to be saved?"

Jesus answered, "Make every single effort to squeeze through the narrow door. A lot of people are going to try to get in later, but they won't be able to. Once the owner locks the door, you can knock all you want, screaming, 'Lord, open up! We ate with you! You taught in our streets!' But he will say, 'I have no idea who you are. Get away from me, you evildoers.' It's not about being near me; it's about actually knowing me."
§That Fox Herod

Some Pharisees warned him, "Get out of here! Herod wants to kill you!" Jesus said, "Go tell that fox: I will keep driving out demons and healing people today and tomorrow, and on the third day I will finish my work. I have to keep moving — a prophet can't die outside Jerusalem."

"Jerusalem, Jerusalem! You kill the prophets and stone the messengers God sends you. How many times I wanted to gather your children like a hen gathers her chicks under her wings — but you refused! Look, your house is abandoned. You won't see me again until you say, 'Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord.'"

Jesus went to eat dinner at the house of a prominent Pharisee leader on the Sabbath. They were watching his every move. A guy with severely swollen limbs (dropsy) was right in front of him. Jesus asked the experts, "Is it legal to heal on the Sabbath or not?" They completely refused to answer. Jesus took hold of the guy, healed him, and sent him home.
Then he noticed how all the honored guests were fighting over the best, most honorable seats at the dinner table. He dropped some savage life advice:

"When you get invited to a massive wedding, don't sit in the honored seat. If someone more important than you shows up, the host is going to make you get up and move to the back in front of everyone. It's humiliating. Instead, go sit in the absolute worst, lowest seat. Then the host will come and say, 'Friend, move up to a better seat!' You'll look like a boss in front of everyone. Because everyone who flexes will be humbled, and the one who humbles himself will be elevated."

He then told the host, "When you throw a party, don't just invite your rich friends, brothers, and rich neighbors, hoping they'll invite you back and repay you. Go out and invite the poor, the crippled, the lame, and the blind. They can't pay you back, but God will reward you at the resurrection."
§The Massive Excuses

Jesus told a story: "A guy threw a massive banquet and invited a ton of important guests. But when the food was ready, every single honored made a lame excuse. One said, 'I just bought a field, I can't come.' Another said, 'I just bought five pairs of oxen, I have to go test them.' Another said, 'I just got married, sorry.'

The host was furious. He told his servant, 'Go out into the streets and alleys right now! Bring in the poor, the crippled, the blind, and the lame.' The servant did, but there was still room. The host said, 'Go out to the country roads and the hedges, and make people come in! I want my house full. But none of those stuck-up guys who made excuses are getting a single taste of my banquet!'"
§The Cost of Following
Massive crowds were following Jesus because he was popular. He turned around and gave them a harsh reality check about what it actually takes to be on his team:

"If you come to me but you don't love me so much more than your own father, mother, wife, kids, brothers, and sisters—yes, even your own life—that it looks like hate in comparison, you cannot be my disciple. And whoever does not carry their cross and follow me cannot be my disciple.

"Think about it. If you're going to build a massive tower, you sit down first and estimate the cost to see if you have enough money to finish it, right? Otherwise, you'll lay the foundation, run out of cash, and everyone will laugh at you.

You have to be willing to give up absolutely everything you have, or you cannot be my disciple. Salt is good, but if it loses its saltiness, it's useless garbage and gets thrown out. If you have ears, listen."

The corrupt tax collectors and the "sinners" (the outcasts and misfits) were all crowding around Jesus just to hear him speak. The Pharisees and religious teachers started muttering, "This guy welcomes outcasts and actually eats with them."
Jesus heard them and responded by dropping three of the most epic stories back-to-back-to-back to explain exactly how God views lost people.
1. The Lost Sheep

"Suppose one of you has 100 sheep, and one wanders off and gets lost. Doesn't he leave the 99 safe sheep in the open country and go track down the lost one until he finds it? And when he finds it, he joyfully puts it on his shoulders, carries it home, and calls all his friends: 'Throw a party! I found my lost sheep!'
I'm telling you, heaven throws a way bigger party over one sinner who changes their life than over 99 'perfect' people who don't think they need to change."
2. The Lost Coin
"Or suppose a woman has ten highly valuable silver coins and loses one.
Doesn't she light a lamp, sweep the entire house, and search like crazy until she finds it? And when she finds it, she calls her friends: 'Throw a party! I found my lost coin!'
I'm telling you, the angels of God throw a massive party when even one sinner repents."
3. The Prodigal Son (The Masterpiece)

"There was a wealthy man who had two sons. The younger son walked up to his dad and basically said, 'I wish you were dead. Give me my half of the inheritance right now.' The dad agreed and split his wealth.

The younger son packed up, moved to a distant country, and completely blew all the money on wild, reckless partying. When he was totally broke, a severe famine hit the country. He was starving. He got a humiliating job feeding pigs, and he was so hungry he actually wanted to eat the pig slop.

Finally, he came to his senses. He thought, 'Even my dad's lowest servants have plenty of food, and I'm out here starving to death. I'll go back and tell him: Dad, I have sinned against heaven and against you. I'm not worthy to be your son anymore. Just hire me as a servant.' So he started the long walk home.

But while the son was still a long way off, his dad saw him. The dad's heart was completely filled with compassion. He hiked up his robes and literally sprinted down the road, threw his arms around his filthy, pig-smelling son, and kissed him.
The son started his rehearsed speech: 'Dad, I've sinned... I'm not worthy...'

But the dad ignored the speech and started yelling to his servants: 'Hurry! Bring the best robe in the house and put it on him! Put the family ring on his finger and sandals on his feet! Go butcher the fattened calf! We are throwing a massive BBQ! My son was dead, and now he is alive again! He was lost, and now he is found!' The party went absolutely crazy.
Meanwhile, the older brother was out working in the field. When he got close to the house and heard the music and dancing, he asked a servant what was going on.
'Your brother is back!' the servant said. 'Your dad killed the fattened calf because he's safe!'
The older brother was absolutely furious. He refused to go inside. His dad came out and begged him to come in.

But the older brother snapped at his dad: 'Look! I've been slaving away for you for years! I never disobeyed a single rule! But you never even gave me a young goat so I could party with my friends. But when this son of yours comes home after blowing your money on immoral women, you throw him a massive feast?!'

The dad looked at him gently. 'My son, you are always with me, and everything I own is already yours. But we had to celebrate and be glad. Because this brother of yours was dead, and now he is alive. He was completely lost, and now he is found.'"
Jesus told his disciples a story about a rich boss who had a shady financial manager. The boss caught the manager wasting his money and fired him: "Turn in your account books. You're done."

The manager panicked. "I'm too weak to do manual labor, and I'm too proud to beg. What am I going to do?" He came up with a genius, totally corrupt plan. He called in all the people who owed his boss money. To the guy who owed 800 gallons of olive oil, the manager said, "Quick, cross that out and write 400." To the guy who owed 1,000 bushels of wheat, he said, "Make it 800." He did this so that when he got kicked out, these guys would owe him a massive favor and let him crash at their houses.
When the rich boss found out, he actually praised the dishonest manager for being so shrewd.

Jesus explained the point: "The people of this world are often way smarter about handling their business than the people of the light. Use your worldly wealth right now to help others and build relationships, so that when your money is completely gone, you'll be welcomed into eternal homes. If you can't be trusted with a little bit of money, nobody is going to trust you with true spiritual wealth. You cannot serve both God and Money."

The Pharisees, who absolutely loved money, heard this and sneered at Jesus. He looked right at them: "You guys love looking good in front of everyone, but God knows your actual hearts. What the world thinks is highly valuable is actually total garbage in God's eyes."
§The Rich Man and Lazarus

Jesus dropped another intense story: "There was an insanely rich man who wore the most expensive purple clothes and partied every single day. Right outside his front gate laid a beggar named Lazarus, covered in sores. Lazarus was so hungry he just wanted the crumbs that fell off the rich guy's table. Even the street dogs would come and lick his sores.
Eventually, both men died.

The angels carried Lazarus right to Abraham's side in heaven. The rich man went to Hades (hell), where he was in absolute agony. He looked up, saw Abraham far away with Lazarus, and screamed, 'Father Abraham! Have pity on me! Send Lazarus to dip just the tip of his finger in water and cool my tongue! I am burning in this fire!'

But Abraham said, 'Son, remember that in your lifetime you had all the good things, and Lazarus had all the bad. Now he is comforted, and you are in agony. Besides, there is a massive, uncrossable chasm fixed between us. Nobody can cross over from here to there, or there to here.'
The rich man begged, 'Then please send him to warn my five brothers so they don't end up in this place of torment!'
Abraham replied, 'They have the Scriptures of Moses and the Prophets. Let them listen to that.'
'No!' the rich man said. 'If someone comes back from the dead, then they'll change their lives!'
Abraham gave the ultimate mic-drop: 'If they won't listen to the Scriptures, they won't be convinced even if someone rises from the dead.'"

Jesus warned his crew about causing other people to stumble: "Temptations to sin are definitely going to happen. But things will go horribly for the person who causes them! It would be better for you to have a massive millstone tied around your neck and be thrown into the ocean than to cause one of these little ones to trip up. Watch yourselves!"

He also gave them a strict rule on forgiveness: "If your brother wrongs you, call him out. If he repents, forgive him. Even if he wrongs you seven times in one day, and comes back seven times saying, 'I repent,' you absolutely must forgive him."
The apostles were overwhelmed. "Lord, increase our faith!"

Jesus replied, "If you have faith even the size of a tiny mustard seed, you could tell this massive mulberry tree, 'Rip yourself up by the roots and plant yourself in the ocean,' and it would obey you."
§The One Who Came Back

While hiking along the border of Samaria and Galilee, ten men covered in severe leprosy saw Jesus. Because they were contagious outcasts, they stood far away and screamed, "Jesus, Master, have pity on us!"
Jesus yelled back, "Go show yourselves to the priests!" (The priests were the only ones who could declare a leper officially clean).
As the ten men turned and walked away, they were instantly completely healed.

But only one of the ten guys stopped, turned around, and ran back, praising God at the top of his lungs. He threw himself face-down at Jesus's feet and thanked him. And this guy was a Samaritan (a hated foreigner).

Jesus asked, "Weren't all ten guys cleansed? Where are the other nine? Was no one else willing to return and give praise to God except this foreigner?" He told the man, "Stand up and go. Your faith has made you well."
When is the Kingdom Coming?
The Pharisees demanded to know exactly when God's kingdom was going to arrive.
Jesus said, "It's not something you can track with a telescope or a calendar. You can't say, 'Here it is!' or 'There it is!' because the kingdom of God is already right here among you."

He told his disciples that when the Son of Man actually returns at the end of the world, it won't be a secret. "It will be like a massive flash of lightning that lights up the entire sky from one end to the other. But first, he must suffer and be rejected by this generation.

It will be exactly like the days of Noah. Everyone was partying, eating, and getting married right up until the second Noah walked into the ark. Then the flood hit and destroyed them all. Don't get so distracted by the world that you miss what's coming. Remember what happened to Lot's wife—she looked back at the destruction, and it cost her everything. Whoever tries to keep their life will lose it, and whoever loses their life will preserve it."
Jesus wanted to teach his guys that they should always pray and never give up. He told them this story:
"There was a corrupt judge in a town who didn't fear God and didn't care about people. A widow kept coming to him, demanding, 'Give me justice against my enemy!'

For a long time, the judge completely ignored her. But she was so relentlessly annoying that he finally said to himself, 'I don't care about God or people, but this widow is driving me absolutely crazy. I'm going to give her justice just so she stops bothering me before she wears me out completely!'"
Jesus explained: "If even a corrupt judge will do the right thing when pressed, don't you think God will quickly bring justice to his chosen people who cry out to him day and night?"
§The Arrogant Leader vs. The Broken Scammer
He aimed this next story directly at people who thought they were spiritually superior to everyone else:
"Two guys went up to the Temple to pray. One was a strict, rule-following Pharisee, and the other was a shady tax collector.

The Pharisee stood by himself and prayed, 'God, I thank you that I am not like other guys—robbers, evildoers, cheaters, or even like this tax collector right here. I fast twice a week and give a full ten percent of everything I make.'
But the tax collector stood far away in the back. He wouldn't even look up to heaven. He beat his chest in absolute sorrow and prayed, 'God, have mercy on me, a sinner.'

I'm telling you, it was the broken tax collector—not the arrogant Pharisee—who went home right with God that day. For everyone who flexes will be humbled, and the one who humbles himself will be elevated."
§The Little Kids

People started bringing their little kids to Jesus so he could bless them, but his disciples tried to shoo them away. Jesus was not happy about that. "Let the little kids come to me!" he said. "Don't stop them, because God's kingdom belongs to people like these. I'm telling you the truth: anyone who doesn't receive God's kingdom like a little kid will never enter it."
§The Impossible Needle
A super wealthy, powerful ruler asked Jesus, "Good teacher, what do I have to do to inherit eternal life?" He swore he had kept all the commandments since he was a kid.
Jesus said, "You still lack one thing. Sell absolutely everything you own, give the money to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven. Then come, follow me."
The ruler became incredibly sad, because his massive wealth was his actual idol.
Jesus looked at him and said, "It is easier to jam a camel through the eye of a needle than for a rich person to enter the kingdom of God."
The people listening panicked. "Then who can be saved?!"
Jesus said, "What is completely impossible for human beings is absolutely possible with God."

As they got close to Jericho, a blind beggar sitting by the road heard the massive crowd walking by. When he found out it was Jesus, he started screaming, "Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me!" The crowd told him to be quiet, but he just yelled louder. Jesus stopped, called him over, and asked, "What do you want me to do for you?"
"Lord, I want to see."
Jesus said, "Receive your sight; your faith has healed you." The guy instantly got his vision back and followed Jesus, praising God.
Jesus entered Jericho. There was a guy living there named Zacchaeus. He wasn't just a regular tax collector; he was the chief tax collector, and he was insanely rich from scamming people.

He desperately wanted to see Jesus, but Zacchaeus was a really short guy, and the crowd was massive. So, he literally sprinted ahead of the crowd and climbed up into a sycamore-fig tree just to get a glimpse.
When Jesus reached the tree, he stopped, looked straight up, and said, "Zacchaeus, come down immediately. I must stay at your house today."
Zacchaeus scrambled down and welcomed him gladly. The entire crowd started grumbling and complaining: "He has gone to be the guest of a total 'sinner.'"

But Zacchaeus stood up and made a massive public promise to Jesus: "Look, Lord! Right here and now, I give half of all my wealth to the poor. And if I have cheated anybody out of anything, I will pay them back four times the amount."
Jesus smiled. "Salvation has come to this house today. For the Son of Man came to seek and to save the lost."
§The Story of the Gold Coins (The Minas)
Because they were getting close to Jerusalem and people thought the kingdom of God was going to appear magically right then, Jesus told them a story:
"A nobleman went to a distant country to be crowned king. Before he left, he called ten of his servants and gave them each a bag of gold. 'Put this money to work until I get back,' he ordered.
But his subjects hated him and sent a message saying, 'We don't want this guy as our king.'
When he returned as king, he called his servants in for an audit.
The first guy said, 'Sir, your gold has earned ten more bags.' 'Awesome job!' the king said. 'Because you were trustworthy with a little, I'm putting you in charge of ten cities.'
The second guy earned five bags, and he got put in charge of five cities.
But another servant came and said, 'Sir, here is your bag of gold. I wrapped it in a cloth and hid it because I was terrified of you. You're a hard man.'

The king was furious. 'You lazy, wicked servant! If you knew I was a hard man, why didn't you at least put my money in the bank to earn some interest?' He took the gold and gave it to the guy who had ten.
Jesus's point: If you use the gifts God gives you, you'll be trusted with more. If you hide them out of fear and do nothing, you'll lose everything."
§The Donkey Parade

When they reached the Mount of Olives just outside Jerusalem, Jesus told two disciples: "Go into the village ahead. You'll find a young donkey tied up that no one has ever ridden. Untie it and bring it here. If anyone asks, just say, 'The Lord needs it.'"

They brought the donkey, threw their cloaks on its back, and Jesus rode it down the massive hill toward the city. The massive crowd of disciples went absolutely crazy, throwing their coats on the road like a red carpet, shouting: "Blessed is the king who comes in the name of the Lord! Peace in heaven and glory in the highest!"
Some tight-lipped Pharisees in the crowd yelled, "Teacher, tell your disciples to be quiet!"
Jesus replied, "I tell you, if they keep quiet, the actual rocks on the ground will start cheering."

As Jesus looked at the massive city of Jerusalem spread out below him, he openly wept. He knew they were going to reject him, and he predicted the horrific destruction that would hit the city years later because they didn't recognize God when He visited them.

Then Jesus rode straight into the Temple area and started physically throwing out the merchants who were scamming people. "It is written," he yelled, "My house will be a house of prayer, but you have turned it into a hangout for thieves!" Every day after that, he taught in the Temple, while the religious leaders desperately tried to figure out a way to assassinate him without starting a riot.
One day, while Jesus was teaching the massive crowds in the Temple courtyard, the chief priests, religious lawyers, and elders stormed up to him.
"Tell us by what authority you are doing all these things!" they demanded. "Who gave you the right to throw people out and teach here?"
Jesus didn't back down. "I'll answer you if you answer one question for me first: John the Baptist's baptism—was it from heaven, or was it just a human idea?"

They held a quick, panicked huddle. "If we say 'from heaven,' he'll ask why we didn't believe John. But if we say 'from humans,' the massive crowd will stone us to death because they are convinced John was a real prophet."
So they cowardly answered, "We don't know."
Jesus replied, "Then I won't tell you by what authority I'm doing these things either." The Story of the Evil Farmers
Jesus then told a story directed right at the corrupt leaders:

"A man planted a massive vineyard, rented it out to some farmers, and moved away. At harvest time, he sent a servant to collect his share of the fruit. But the farmers beat the servant up and sent him away with nothing. The owner sent a second servant; they beat him too. He sent a third; they wounded him and threw him out.
Finally, the owner said, 'I will send my own son, whom I love. They will respect him.'
But when the farmers saw the son, they plotted: 'This is the heir! Let's murder him, and the vineyard will be ours!' So they threw him out of the vineyard and killed him.
What will the owner do to those guys?" Jesus asked. "He will come, completely destroy those farmers, and give the vineyard to others."

The religious leaders realized Jesus was talking directly about them (they were the evil farmers, God was the owner, and Jesus was the son they were about to kill). They wanted to arrest him right then and there, but they were too afraid of the crowd.
§The Tax Trap and the Resurrection Trap
Next, they sent spies to trap him with a political question: "Teacher, is it legal for us to pay taxes to Caesar or not?"
Jesus saw right through their scam. "Show me a denarius coin. Whose portrait and name are on it?"
"Caesar's," they replied.
Jesus dropped the hammer: "Then give back to Caesar what is Caesar's, and give back to God what is God's." They were totally stunned into silence.

Then the Sadducees (a religious group who didn't believe in the afterlife or resurrection) tried to trap him with a ridiculous hypothetical question about a woman who had been married to seven different brothers sequentially after they each died. "At the resurrection, whose wife will she be?" they mocked.

Jesus shut them down: "You guys don't understand heaven. People who rise from the dead don't get married; they are like angels and never die again. And as for the dead rising, even Moses proved it when he called the Lord 'the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.' He is not the God of the dead, but of the living! To him, they are all alive."
Some of the teachers of the law actually said, "Well said, Teacher!" And after that, nobody had the guts to ask him any more trick questions.
Jesus was hanging out at the Temple, watching rich people flex by dropping massive bags of cash into the offering boxes. Then he saw a poor widow walk up and drop in two tiny copper coins.

He looked at his guys and said, "I'm telling you the truth, this poor widow just out-gave all of them. The rich people just tossed in their spare change, but she is completely broke and still gave everything she had to live on."
§The Temple Takedown
Later, some people were talking about how incredibly beautiful the Temple was, with its massive stones and expensive decorations.

Jesus completely popped their bubble: "Take a good look at all this. The day is coming when this massive building is going to be completely leveled. Not a single stone will be left stacked on top of another."
They panicked. "Teacher, when is this going to happen? What's the warning sign?"
§Jesus gave them a heavy reality check about the future:
"Don't get scammed. A bunch of guys are going to show up claiming, 'I am the Messiah!' Don't follow them.
You're going to hear about massive wars and revolutions. Don't panic. That stuff has to happen first.
There will be massive earthquakes, famines, and deadly diseases. There will be terrifying events in the sky.
But before any of that, the world is going to turn on you. They will arrest you, drag you into court, and throw you in prison just because you have my name.
But here is the game plan: Don't practice your defense speeches ahead of time. I will personally give you the words and the wisdom, and your enemies won't be able to argue with you at all.

Your own parents, brothers, and friends will betray you. Some of you will be killed. Everyone will hate you because of me. But not a single hair on your head will ultimately be destroyed. Stand firm, and you will win your souls."
§The Grand Finale
Jesus told them that Jerusalem would eventually be surrounded by armies and completely crushed.

"Then, the whole world is going to see the Son of Man coming in a cloud with massive power and blinding glory. When you see all this chaotic stuff start to happen, stand up straight and lift your heads high, because your rescue is right around the corner."

He warned them to stay sharp: "Be careful! Don't let your hearts get weighed down by partying, getting drunk, or stressing out about the anxieties of everyday life. If you do, that day will snap shut on you like a trap. Stay awake, and pray that you'll have the strength to survive all this and stand in front of the Son of Man."
The Festival of Unleavened Bread (Passover) was approaching, and the corrupt chief priests were desperately looking for a quiet way to assassinate Jesus without the massive crowds rioting.

Suddenly, Satan entered Judas Iscariot, one of the original Twelve. Judas snuck off to the religious mafia and the Temple police, and they worked out a deal: they would pay him cash, and he would secretly tell them Jesus's location when no crowds were around.
§The Last Supper
Jesus sent Peter and John to prep the Passover meal. That evening, he sat down with his core crew.
"I have been dying to eat this Passover meal with you before my suffering begins," Jesus said.
He took some bread, gave thanks to God, broke it, and handed it to them: "This is my body, which is given for you. Do this to remember me."

After supper, he took a cup of wine: "This cup is the new covenant sealed in my blood, which is poured out for you. But look—the hand of the guy who is going to betray me is resting on this very table."
Right after this incredibly heavy, spiritual moment, the disciples actually started arguing again about which one of them was the greatest.

Jesus roasted their egos: "The kings of this world boss people around and demand to be called 'Benefactors.' You guys are not going to operate like that. The greatest guy among you needs to act like the youngest, and the boss needs to act like the servant. Who is greater: the guy eating at the table, or the guy serving the food? Obviously the guy eating. But look at me—I am among you as the guy who serves."

Jesus turned to Peter: "Simon, Simon. Satan has asked to sift all of you like wheat. But I have prayed specifically for you, Simon, that your faith won't completely fail. When you eventually turn back to me, you need to strengthen your brothers."
Peter puffed out his chest: "Lord, I am ready to go to prison with you, and even die with you!"
Jesus looked at him sadly. "Peter, before the rooster crows tomorrow morning, you will deny you even know me three separate times."
§The Ambush in the Dark

They went out to the Mount of Olives. Jesus told them, "Pray that you don't fall into temptation." He walked about a stone's throw away, fell to his knees, and prayed in absolute agony. "Father, if you are willing, take this cup of suffering away from me. But not what I want—what you want." He was in such intense psychological stress that his sweat fell to the ground like massive drops of blood.
When he got up and went back to his guys, they were completely passed out, exhausted from sorrow. "Why are you sleeping?!" he asked. "Get up and pray!"
While he was still talking, a massive, heavily armed mob showed up out of the dark. Judas walked right up to the front and kissed Jesus on the cheek.
Jesus said, "Judas. Are you really betraying the Son of Man with a kiss?"
When Jesus's guys realized what was happening, one of them pulled a sword, swung wildly, and sliced off the right ear of the high priest's servant.
Jesus yelled, "No more of this!" He reached out, touched the guy's bloody ear, and completely healed it.

Then he looked at the religious mafia leading the mob: "Am I some kind of dangerous terrorist, that you had to come after me with swords and clubs? I was with you in the Temple every single day, and you didn't touch me. But this is your hour—the time when darkness rules."
§Peter's Absolute Fail
They arrested Jesus and dragged him to the high priest's massive house. Peter followed from a safe distance and sat down by a fire pit in the middle of the courtyard to blend in.
A servant girl stared at him in the firelight. "This guy was with him!"
Peter panicked. "Woman, I don't even know him!"
A little later, a guy looked at him. "You're definitely one of them."
"Man, I am not!" Peter shot back.
About an hour later, another guy insisted, "This guy is absolutely one of them. He has a Galilean accent!"
Peter lost it. "Man, I don't know what you're talking about!"
The exact second those words left his mouth, a rooster crowed.
Jesus, who was being held nearby, turned and looked straight at Peter. Peter suddenly remembered what Jesus had said. He ran out of the courtyard and completely broke down, sobbing uncontrollably.
Meanwhile, the guards holding Jesus blindfolded him, beat him, and mocked him: "Prophesy! Who just hit you?"
At dawn, the council of religious elders put Jesus on trial. "If you are the Messiah, tell us!"
Jesus replied, "If I tell you, you won't believe me. But from now on, the Son of Man will be seated at the right hand of the mighty God."
They all shouted, "So, are you the Son of God then?"
Jesus answered, "You say that I am."
They yelled, "We don't need any more witnesses! We heard it from his own mouth!"

The whole religious council dragged Jesus to Pilate, the Roman governor, and started throwing fake political charges at him: "This guy is trying to start a rebellion, telling people not to pay taxes, and claiming he's a king!"
Pilate asked Jesus, "Are you the king of the Jews?"
"You have said so," Jesus replied.
Pilate looked at the chief priests and the massive crowd. "I don't find any reason to charge this guy with a crime."

But the leaders kept screaming, so Pilate tried to pass the buck. He found out Jesus was from Galilee, which meant he was under King Herod's jurisdiction. Herod happened to be in Jerusalem, so Pilate sent Jesus to him.

Herod was thrilled. He had heard the hype and wanted to see Jesus perform a miracle. But Jesus refused to answer a single one of Herod's questions. Herod and his soldiers got bored, mocked Jesus, threw an elegant robe on him as a joke, and sent him back to Pilate.
Pilate called the crowd together again. "Listen, neither Herod nor I found this guy guilty of anything. I'm going to have him whipped and then let him go."
But the mob went completely feral. "Kill him! Give us Barabbas instead!" (Barabbas was a literal murderer and a terrorist who had started a riot in the city).

Pilate tried to argue with them, but the mob just kept screaming, "Crucify him! Crucify him!" Their shouting was so intense that Pilate completely caved. He released the murderer and handed Jesus over to be executed.
§The Walk to the Skull

As they led Jesus away, he was so physically destroyed that he couldn't carry the heavy wooden cross. The guards grabbed a random guy out of the crowd named Simon from Cyrene and forced him to carry it behind Jesus.

A massive crowd followed, including women who were weeping and wailing for him. Jesus turned to them and said, "Daughters of Jerusalem, don't cry for me. Cry for yourselves and your kids, because incredibly dark days are coming to this city."
When they reached the place called The Skull (Golgotha), they nailed him to the cross, right between two criminals.
Even while they were murdering him, Jesus prayed: "Father, forgive them, for they don't know what they are doing."
The Roman soldiers sat around and rolled dice to see who got to keep his clothes. The religious leaders sneered, "He saved others; let him save himself if he's really God's Messiah!"
One of the criminals hanging next to him started trash-talking too: "Aren't you the Messiah? Save yourself and us!"

But the other criminal shut him down. "Don't you fear God? We are getting exactly what we deserve for our crimes. But this guy hasn't done anything wrong." Then he looked at Jesus. "Jesus, remember me when you come into your kingdom."
Jesus looked back at him and said, "I am telling you the truth: today you will be with me in paradise."
§The Sky Goes Dark
At noon, the sun literally stopped shining, and darkness covered the entire land for three hours. The massive, thick curtain hanging inside the Temple ripped right down the middle.
Jesus called out with a massive voice, "Father, into your hands I commit my spirit." When he said this, he died.
The Roman Centurion running the execution saw exactly how Jesus died. He praised God and said, "Surely this was a righteous man."

A good, honorable Jewish leader named Joseph from Arimathea (who hadn't agreed with the council's decision) went to Pilate and bravely asked for Jesus's body. He took the body down, wrapped it in linen cloth, and placed it in a tomb cut right out of solid rock, where nobody had ever been buried. It was Friday afternoon, and the Sabbath was about to start, so the women who followed Jesus went home to prepare spices and perfumes to anoint his body on Sunday.
Very early on Sunday morning, the women took the spices to the tomb.
They found the massive stone rolled completely away from the entrance! They walked in, but the body of the Lord Jesus was gone.
While they were standing there totally confused, two men wearing clothes that literally flashed like lightning suddenly stood beside them. The women were terrified and dropped face-down to the dirt.

The glowing men said to them: "Why are you looking for the living among the dead? He isn't here; he has risen! Remember what he told you back in Galilee: The Son of Man had to be handed over to sinners, be crucified, and on the third day rise again."
Then it clicked. They remembered his words.
They sprinted back from the tomb and told the eleven apostles and everyone else what happened. (It was Mary Magdalene, Joanna, Mary the mother of James, and a few others).

But the guys thought the women were talking absolute nonsense and didn't believe a word of it. Peter, however, jumped up and literally sprinted to the tomb. He bent over, looked in, and saw only the strips of linen lying there. He walked away completely mind-blown, wondering what in the world had happened.
§Undercover on the Road to Emmaus
That exact same day, two of Jesus's followers were walking to a village called Emmaus, about seven miles outside Jerusalem. They were talking about the insane events of the weekend.
While they were debating, Jesus himself walked up and started traveling with them, but God kept them from recognizing him.
Jesus asked, "What are you guys arguing about?"
They stopped dead in their tracks, looking absolutely devastated. One guy, Cleopas, said, "Are you the only visitor in Jerusalem who doesn't know what just happened?"
"What things?" Jesus asked.

"About Jesus of Nazareth!" they replied. "He was a massive prophet. We totally thought he was the one who was going to rescue Israel. But the chief priests handed him over, and they crucified him. And now, some women from our group totally blew our minds. They went to the tomb this morning, couldn't find his body, and claimed they saw angels who said he was alive! Some of our guys went to check, and the tomb was empty, but they didn't see him."

Jesus essentially said, "You guys are so slow to catch on! Didn't the Messiah have to suffer all these things before entering his glory?" Then, starting all the way back with Moses and the prophets, Jesus explained exactly how the entire Old Testament pointed straight to him.
When they got to Emmaus, Jesus acted like he was going to keep walking. But they begged him, "Stay with us, it's getting dark!" So he went in.
When they sat down at the table, Jesus took the bread, gave thanks, broke it, and handed it to them.
Instantly, their eyes were opened, and they realized it was him! And the second they recognized him, he literally vanished into thin air.
They looked at each other. "Weren't our hearts burning inside us when he was explaining the Scriptures on the road?!"

They didn't even care that it was dark; they got up immediately and ran all seven miles back to Jerusalem. They burst into the room where the Eleven were hiding and yelled, "It's true! The Lord has risen!"
§The Final Boss Move
While they were still telling the story, Jesus himself suddenly materialized right in the middle of the room. "Peace be with you," he said.
They absolutely lost their minds with terror, thinking they were seeing a ghost.
"Why are you so freaked out? Why are you doubting? Look at my hands and my feet. It's really me! Touch me and see. Ghosts don't have flesh and bones like I do." He showed them the nail scars.
They were so full of joy and shock they still couldn't process it. So Jesus asked, "Do you guys have anything to eat here?"
They handed him a piece of broiled fish, and he ate it right in front of them just to prove he was physically, totally alive.

He looked at his team. "This is exactly what I told you when I was still with you: Everything written about me in the Law, the Prophets, and the Psalms had to be fulfilled." Then he opened their minds so they could finally fully understand the Bible.

"This is what is written: The Messiah will suffer and rise from the dead on the third day. Now, forgiveness of sins will be preached in his name to all nations, starting right here in Jerusalem. You are my official witnesses. I am going to send you what my Father promised; but stay in the city until you are completely clothed with power from heaven."
Jesus led them out to the vicinity of Bethany. He lifted his hands and blessed them. While he was blessing them, he physically left them and was taken straight up into heaven.
His disciples fell down and worshipped him, and then returned to Jerusalem with massive, unstoppable joy. They stayed continually at the Temple, praising God.

우리 사이에서 일어났던 일들을 글로 남기려고 했던 사람들이 꽤 많았대. 이 이야기들은 처음부터 모든 걸 직접 보고 자기 삶을 바쳐서 말씀을 섬겼던 사람들이 전해준 거거든요. 이야기의 시작부터 모든 자료를 꼼꼼하게 훑어본 나도, 데오빌로 각하를 위해서 모든 걸 자세하게 써야겠다고 마음먹었어요. 각하께서 지금까지 배우신 것들이 진짜 확실한 사실이라는 걸 아셨으면 해서 말이에요.
유대 왕 헤롯 시절에, 아비야 조에 속한 사가랴라는 제사장이 있었어요. 그의 아내는 아론의 자손이고 이름은 엘리사벳이었죠. 이 부부는 하나님 앞에서 정말 바르게 살면서 모든 계명을 철저하게 지켰어요. 흠잡을 데가 없었죠. 근데 엘리사벳이 아이를 낳지 못해서 자식이 없었고, 둘 다 나이가 엄청 많았대요.

마침 사가랴가 자기 순서가 돼서 하나님 앞에서 제사장 일을 하고 있었는데, 제비뽑기에서 뽑혀서 하나님의 성소에 들어가 분향하는 일을 맡게 됐어요. 이건 제사장으로서 평생 한 번 할까 말까 한 영광스러운 일이었죠. 사가랴가 안에서 분향하는 동안, 밖에서는 많은 사람들이 모여서 기도하고 있었어요. 바로 그때, 주님의 천사가 갑자기 나타나서 분향 제단 오른쪽에 섰어요. 사가랴는 그 모습을 보고 너무 놀라서 완전 얼어붙었죠.

천사가 그를 안심시키며 말했어요. "사가랴, 겁내지 마세요. 하나님이 여러분의 기도를 들으셨어요. 여러분의 아내 엘리사벳이 아들을 낳을 건데, 이름은 요한이라고 지어주세요. 여러분은 진짜 기뻐서 날뛸 것이고, 많은 사람들이 그의 탄생을 함께 기뻐할 거예요. 그는 주님 앞에서 위대한 인물이 될 거거든요. 포도주나 독한 술은 입에도 대지 않고, 엄마 뱃속에서부터 성령으로 충만할 거예요. 그리고 이스라엘 자손 중에서 많은 사람들을 그들의 주 하나님께로 돌아오게 할 거예요. 그는 엘리야의 영과 능력으로 주님보다 먼저 와서, 아버지의 마음을 자식에게로, 거역하는 사람들을 의인의 지혜로 돌아오게 해서, 주님을 맞이할 백성을 준비시킬 거예요."
사가랴가 천사에게 물었어요. "아니, 그걸 제가 어떻게 믿을 수 있나요? 저는 이제 늙었고, 제 아내도 나이가 많은데요."
천사가 대답했죠. "저는 하나님 앞에 서 있는 가브리엘입니다. 이 기쁜 소식을 여러분에게 전해주려고 보냄을 받았어요. 근데 여러분이 제 말을 믿지 않으니까, 이 일이 이루어지는 날까지 여러분은 벙어리가 돼서 말을 못하게 될 거예요. 제 말은 때가 되면 반드시 이루어질 거거든요."
한편, 밖에서 기다리던 사람들은 사가랴가 성소에서 너무 늦게 나오니까 이상하게 생각했어요. 그가 나와서도 말을 못 하니까, 사람들은 그가 성소 안에서 환상을 본 거라고 짐작했죠. 사가랴는 정해진 임무 기간이 끝날 때까지 사람들에게 손짓으로만 의사를 전달하고, 말을 못했어요. 임무를 마친 후에 그는 집으로 돌아갔죠.
그 후에 그의 아내 엘리사벳이 진짜로 임신을 했어요! 그리고 다섯 달 동안 숨어 지내면서 이렇게 말했대요. "주님께서 저를 이렇게 돌봐주셨어요. 이제 사람들 앞에서 부끄러워하지 않아도 돼요!"

엘리사벳이 임신한 지 여섯 달째 되던 때, 하나님께서 가브리엘 천사를 갈릴리의 나사렛이라는 동네로 보내셨어요. 다윗의 자손인 요셉이라는 남자와 약혼한 처녀에게 보낸 거였죠. 그 처녀의 이름은 마리아였어요. 천사가 마리아에게 가서 말했어요. "기뻐하세요, 은혜를 받은 자여! 주님께서 여러분과 함께하십니다." 마리아는 이 말을 듣고 완전 당황해서 '이게 대체 무슨 인사지?' 하고 생각했어요. 천사가 말했죠. "마리아, 무서워하지 마세요. 여러분이 하나님께 은혜를 입었어요. 이제 여러분이 임신해서 아들을 낳을 건데, 이름은 예수라고 하세요. 그는 위대하게 되고, 가장 높으신 분의 아들이라고 불릴 거예요. 주 하나님께서 그에게 그의 조상 다윗의 왕위를 주실 것이고, 그는 영원히 야곱의 집을 다스릴 것이며, 그의 나라는 끝이 없을 거예요."

마리아가 천사에게 물었어요. "아니, 저는 아직 결혼도 안 했는데 어떻게 그런 일이 있을 수 있나요?" 천사가 대답했죠. "성령님이 여러분에게 임하시고, 가장 높으신 분의 능력이 여러분을 감싸주실 거예요. 그래서 태어날 아기는 거룩한 분, 바로 하나님의 아들이라고 불릴 거예요. 보세요, 여러분의 친척 엘리사벳도 늙어서 아들을 가졌잖아요. 임신 못한다고 알려졌던 그가 벌써 여섯 달이나 됐어요. 하나님께는 불가능한 일이 없거든요." 마리아가 말했어요. "저는 주님의 여종입니다. 말씀하신 대로 저에게 이루어지기를 바랍니다." 그러자 천사는 떠나갔어요.

그 후에 마리아는 서둘러 유대 산골에 있는 한 동네로 가서 사가랴의 집에 들어가 엘리사벳에게 인사했어요. 엘리사벳이 마리아의 인사를 받자, 뱃속의 아기가 막 뛰노는 거예요! 엘리사벳은 성령으로 충만해져서 큰 소리로 외쳤어요. "당신은 여자들 중에서 가장 복 받은 사람이고, 당신 뱃속의 아기도 복 받았어요! 내 주님의 어머니가 나에게 오시다니, 이게 웬일이에요? 당신의 인사말이 내 귀에 들리자마자, 내 뱃속의 아기가 기뻐서 뛰놀았다니까요. 주님께서 하신 말씀이 반드시 이루어질 거라고 믿은 여자는 정말 복됩니다!"

그러자 마리아가 노래했어요.
"내 영혼이 주님을 찬양하고, 내 마음이 내 구원자 하나님 안에서 기뻐 날뛰어요. 그분이 이 비천한 여종을 돌아보셨거든요. 이제부터 모든 세대가 저를 복되다고 할 거예요. 전능하신 분이 저에게 엄청난 일을 하셨으니, 그 이름은 거룩합니다. 그분의 자비는 그를 경외하는 사람들에게 대대로 이어져요. 그분은 팔로 힘을 보이셔서, 마음이 교만한 사람들을 흩어버리셨어요. 권력자들을 그 자리에서 끌어내리시고, 비천한 사람들을 높이셨죠. 굶주린 사람들은 좋은 것으로 배불리시고, 부자들은 빈손으로 돌려보내셨어요. 그분은 자비를 기억하셔서, 자기 종 이스라엘을 도우셨어요. 우리 조상들에게 말씀하신 대로, 아브라함과 그의 자손에게 영원히 그렇게 하실 거예요."
마리아는 엘리사벳과 함께 석 달쯤 머물다가 자기 집으로 돌아갔어요.
엘리사벳은 이제 아기를 낳을 때가 돼서 아들을 낳았어요. 이웃과 친척들은 주님께서 그녀에게 큰 자비를 베푸셨다는 소식을 듣고 함께 기뻐해 줬죠.

아기가 태어난 지 8일째 되는 날, 할례를 하러 사람들이 왔어요. 그들은 아버지의 이름을 따서 아기 이름을 사가랴라고 지으려고 했죠. 근데 아기 엄마가 "안 돼요! 이름은 요한이라고 해야 해요." 하고 나섰어요. 사람들이 "아니, 당신 친척 중에는 그런 이름이 없잖아요?" 하면서 아기 아빠에게 손짓으로 아기 이름을 뭘로 하고 싶은지 물었어요. 그가 서판을 달라고 해서 이렇게 썼죠. "얘 이름은 요한입니다." 다들 완전 깜짝 놀랐어요.
바로 그 순간, 사가랴의 입이 열리고 혀가 풀리면서 말을 하기 시작했는데, 하나님을 찬양하는 거였어요! 주변에 사는 모든 사람들이 두려워했고, 이 모든 이야기는 유대 온 산골에 쫙 퍼졌죠. 소문을 들은 사람들은 모두 이 일을 마음에 새기면서 "이 아이가 장차 어떤 인물이 될까요?" 하고 수군거렸어요. 진짜로 주님의 손이 그와 함께하셨거든요.

그의 아버지 사가랴가 성령으로 충만해서 예언했어요.
"이스라엘의 주 하나님을 찬양하세요! 그분이 자기 백성을 돌보시고 구원하셨습니다. 우리를 위해 구원의 뿔을 그의 종 다윗의 집에 일으키셨으니, 이것은 예로부터 거룩한 예언자들의 입으로 말씀하신 그대로예요. 우리를 원수들에게서, 그리고 우리를 미워하는 모든 사람들의 손에서 구원하시는 구원이죠. 우리 조상들에게 자비를 베푸시고, 그 거룩한 언약을 기억하셨으니, 곧 우리 조상 아브라함에게 하신 맹세예요. 우리가 원수의 손에서 구출되어, 평생 동안 주님 앞에서 두려움 없이 거룩함과 의로움으로 섬기게 하려는 것이죠. 아가야, 여러분은 가장 높으신 분의 예언자라고 불릴 거예요. 주님보다 앞서 가서 그의 길을 준비하고, 죄 사함을 통해 얻는 구원을 그의 백성에게 알려줄 거거든요. 이것은 우리 하나님의 긍휼하심 덕분이에요. 해가 위에서부터 우리에게 돋아나서, 어둠과 죽음의 그늘에 앉은 사람들을 비추고, 우리 발을 평화의 길로 인도할 거예요."
아기는 무럭무럭 자라면서 마음도 강해졌어요. 그리고 이스라엘 사람들 앞에 공식적으로 나타날 때까지 광야에서 지냈대요.
예수의 탄생

그때쯤 아우구스투스 황제가 명령을 내려서 제국 전체에 인구조사를 하라고 했대. 이건 구레뇨가 시리아 총독일 때 했던 첫 번째 인구조사였음. 모든 사람이 자기 조상 고향으로 가서 조사를 받아야만 했지. 요셉도 인구조사 받으러 갈릴리 나사렛 마을에서 다윗의 동네인 유대 베들레헴으로 올라갔어요. 다윗의 자손이라서 거기로 가야 했던 거예요. 약혼녀 마리아랑 같이 갔는데, 마리아는 임신 중이었대.
그들이 거기 있는 동안 마리아가 아기 낳을 때가 된 거예요. 그래서 첫아들을 낳았는데, 여관에 방이 하나도 없어서 아기를 포대기에 싸서 구유에 눕혔대.
목자들이 예수 탄생 소식을 듣다

그 근처 들판에서 목자들이 밤새 양 떼를 지키고 있었어요. 근데 갑자기 하나님의 천사가 그들 앞에 딱 나타나고, 하나님의 영광이 막 비추는 거예요. 목자들은 완전 쫄았죠. 천사가 말했어요. “놀라지 마세요. 제가 온 건 온 세상 모든 사람에게 정말 놀랍고 기쁜 소식을 알려주려고 온 거예요. 방금 다윗의 동네에 구세주가 태어나셨는데, 그분이 바로 메시아고 주님이세요. 가서 포대기에 싸여 구유에 뉘어 있는 아기를 찾아보세요.”
그랬더니 갑자기 완전 많은 천사 합창단이 나타나서 그 천사랑 같이 하나님을 찬양하는 거예요. “높은 하늘에서는 하나님께 영광, 땅에서는 하나님이 기뻐하시는 모든 사람에게 평화!”

천사들이 하늘로 돌아가니까 목자들이 서로 얘기했어요. “야, 빨리 베들레헴으로 가서 하나님이 우리한테 보여주신 거 직접 보자.” 그들은 바로 뛰어가서 마리아랑 요셉, 그리고 구유에 누워 있는 아기를 찾아냈죠. 목자들은 자기 눈으로 직접 보고 나니까 진짜 믿게 된 거예요. 그래서 만나는 사람마다 천사들이 그 아기에 대해 해준 말을 다 전했대요. 그 얘기를 들은 사람들은 다들 완전 감동받았어요.
마리아는 이 모든 일들을 마음속에 잘 간직해 뒀어요. 목자들은 자기들이 보고 들은 모든 것 때문에 하나님께 영광이랑 찬송을 돌리면서 벅찬 가슴으로 돌아갔죠. 진짜 자기들이 들었던 거랑 완전 똑같았던 거예요.
아기 예수의 정결의식
여드레째 되는 날, 할례를 해야 해서 아기 이름을 예수라고 지었어요. 이건 아기가 생기기 전에 천사가 알려준 이름이었대요.
모세 율법에 따라서 정결예식을 해야 하는 날이 되니까, 마리아랑 요셉은 아기를 데리고 예루살렘으로 올라갔어요. “엄마 배에서 처음 나온 남자는 다 하나님께 거룩한 제물이 되어야 한다”는 율법에 따라 아기를 하나님께 바치려고 한 거죠. 그리고 율법에 정해진 대로 “비둘기 한 쌍이나 집비둘기 녀석 두 마리”를 제물로 바치려고도 했고요.

그때 예루살렘에 시므온이라는 사람이 있었는데, 이 사람은 이스라엘이 구원받기를 기도하면서 착하게 살던 사람이었어요. 성령님이 그 사람 위에 계셨죠. 예전에 성령님이 그가 죽기 전에 하나님의 메시아를 보게 될 거라고 알려주셨대요. 시므온은 성령에 이끌려서 성전으로 들어갔어요. 마침 예수의 부모님이 율법대로 예식을 하려고 아기를 데리고 온 거예요. 시므온은 아기를 품에 안고 하나님을 찬양했어요.
“하나님, 이제 약속하신 대로 저를 평안히 보내주세요. 제 눈으로 주님의 구원을 봤습니다. 이건 모든 사람이 볼 수 있게 드러난 것이고, 다른 나라들한테는 하나님을 보여주는 빛이고, 주님의 백성 이스라엘에게는 영광입니다.”

예수 부모님은 이 말에 너무 놀라서 아무 말도 못 했어요. 시므온이 그들을 축복하면서 엄마 마리아한테 말했죠. “이 아기는 이스라엘에서 많은 사람들의 실패와 회복의 상징이 될 것이고, 오해랑 반대도 많이 받을 인물이에요. 당신 마음이 칼에 찔리는 듯한 고통일 겁니다. 하지만 그들의 거부가 오히려 가면을 벗겨서, 결국 하나님이 그들의 진짜 모습을 드러내실 거예요.”

아셀 지파 바누엘의 딸인 예언자 안나도 거기에 있었어요. 안나는 나이가 엄청 많았는데, 결혼하고 7년 만에 남편이 죽고 84살이 될 때까지 과부로 살았대요. 안나는 성전을 떠나지 않고 금식하고 기도하면서 밤낮으로 하나님께 예배드렸죠. 시므온이 기도하고 있을 때 바로 그때 안나가 나타나서 하나님께 찬송을 드리면서, 예루살렘의 해방을 간절히 기다리던 모든 사람에게 이 아기에 대해 말해줬어요.
마리아와 요셉은 하나님 율법에 정해진 일을 다 마치고 갈릴리에 있는 자기 동네 나사렛으로 돌아왔어요. 거기서 아기는 튼튼하고 지혜롭게 자랐죠. 하나님의 은혜가 그 아이 위에 있었대요.
성전에서 아이 예수를 찾다

해마다 유월절이 되면 예수의 부모님은 예루살렘으로 갔어요. 예수가 열두 살 되던 해에도 늘 하던 대로 유월절 지키러 올라갔죠. 절기가 끝나고 집으로 돌아가는데, 어린 예수는 예루살렘에 남아 있었지만 부모님은 그걸 몰랐던 거예요. 그들은 예수님이 순례자들 무리 어딘가에 있겠거니 하고 하루 종일 걷고 나서야 친척이랑 이웃들 사이에서 찾기 시작했어요. 근데 안 보이니까 다시 예루살렘으로 돌아가서 찾았죠.
다음 날, 예수의 부모님은 성전에서 아들을 찾았어요. 예수는 선생님들 사이에 앉아서 그들이 하는 말을 듣기도 하고 질문도 하고 있었던 거예요. 선생님들은 예수의 대단한 답변에 감탄하면서 완전 푹 빠져 있었죠. 근데 부모님은 감탄은커녕, 화나고 속상했어요. 엄마가 말했죠. “아들, 왜 그랬어요? 아빠랑 제가 여러분을 찾느라 완전 정신없었다고요.”
예수가 말했어요. “왜 저를 찾으셨어요? 제가 여기 있으면서 제 아버지의 일을 해야 하는 거 모르셨어요?” 근데 부모님은 그게 무슨 말인지 이해를 못 했대요.
예수는 부모님이랑 같이 나사렛으로 돌아와서 순종하며 살았어요. 엄마는 이 일을 마음속 깊이 간직했죠. 예수는 하나님과 사람들한테 칭찬받으면서 몸도 마음도 쑥쑥 자라났대요.
